# FROM NOTHING - Linkin Park tribute band

> Official website of From Nothing, a Polish Linkin Park tribute band.

From Nothing performs the music of Linkin Park live. This website contains the band's concert information, lineup, video, official social profiles, and booking contact details.

## Language versions

The official website is available in two language variants:

- [Polish version](https://fromnothing.pl/)
- [English version](https://fromnothing.pl/?lang=en)

## Pages

- [Home](https://fromnothing.pl/) — shows, lineup, and booking form
- [Listen to us](https://fromnothing.pl/posluchajnas) — video player with a compilation recorded at rehearsal ([English](https://fromnothing.pl/posluchajnas?lang=en))

## Documents

- [Booking offer, 2026/2027](https://fromnothing.pl/oferta) — PDF, Polish
- [Technical rider](https://fromnothing.pl/rider) — PDF; currently a placeholder, the rider is in preparation and is sent on request

## Members

- Mery: vocals
- Janusz: vocals and guitar
- Patryk: guitar
- Wojtek: drums
- Damian: bass guitar
